answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, clawed back after a replayed submission, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. By the cipher of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The quill lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the ocean is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
